BEATS ME![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/e30439bf9964e4689ce8d7a4991b3f51d6c0c166.png"][/img][/p][h2]🚨 IN CONCLUSION:[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Take pictures of the Vigilante[/p][/*][*][p]Get them to my desk [url="https://x.com/AmongUs3DGame"]through X[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Become the front page photo of the Skeld Sentinel[/p][/*][*][p]Walk away with your own Vigilante Cosmetic set[/p][/*][*][p]EXPOSE THE MASKED MENACE ONCE AND FOR ALL![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]And [url="https://schellgames.com/terms-and-conditions-for-among-us-3d-front-page-vigilante-giveaway-promotion"]here's the fine print[/url] so hr gets off my back. Now go GET ME MY PICTURES![/p][p][/p][p]–B. Bowen Beaneson, out.[/p]

notes.title: Break Out Your Cape 💥 DUM Justice Begins on May 29
notes.content:
Hey there, beans!

In just seven days, on May 29, 2025, our next Limited Time Event emerges from the shadows with a vengeance. Get ready to take justice into your own hands! 💥 It's time to suit up for DUM Justice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/5418aafea9e41104b9bf9415f984e410fd21ec1a.png[/img]
DUM Justice brings the Vigilante role out of the shadows and into the arena. 🥊 Equipped with their own Kill ability, the Vigilante fights on Team Crewmate for love 💗, justice ⚖️, and vengeance ☠️. But, be warned — with great power comes great responsi-bean-ity! 🕸️ A Vigilante's Kill ability can be performed on ANY bean, Crewmate OR Impostor! 😱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/b6526c69a2e22cd6b91c4a5193ca34bb4179ec58.gif[/img]

VR Crewmates may recognize the Vigilante role [url=https://www.innersloth.com/auvr-lte3-dum-justice]from last year[/url]. DUM Justice ran as a Limited Time Event back in the [i]Among Us VR[/i] days, before the rebrand. ⌛ We've heard your requests to bring the role back, and so... we're answering the call and upping the ante. 😤

[h3]✨ The Vigilante permanently joins the role roster this time! ✨[/h3]

That's right! While you'll be able to hop into our preset DUM Justice lobbies throughout this event, you'll also be able to customize your own lobbies and integrate the Vigilante role into them how you see fit. For good! [i](Or for evil. The choice is yours!)[/i] And you'll be able to add this role forever, long after this limited-time event ends.

💀 We're also upgrading the suit and releasing a new Vigilante cosmetic set — [b]The Masked Zinger Bundle[/b]! Take on injustice with the [b]Vigilante Mask: Year One[/b] hat, Digits of Doom[b][/b] gloves, and [b]Caped Crewsader[/b] skin. And don't worry — your secret identity is safe, because wearing these items does not guarantee you the Vigilante role.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/2f822bda85fc60924ca2799704205938a988d928.png[/img]
Lastly, we want to take a moment to address the Impostor in the vent.

Alongside our upcoming content releases, we're working diligently on resolutions for performance issues, bug fixes, reviewing our moderation tools, and evaluating additional opportunities to help improve your experience in the game. Already under consideration are a number of improvements that we think will really help address your concerns. We are looking forward to being able to share more specific details for these updates soon.

It's important to us that you enjoy your time with [i]Among Us 3D[/i]. So, we greatly appreciate the care and thought that you, our community, put into an experience that we all love. Our dev team is looking forward to continuing to refine, improve, and expand [i]Among Us 3D[/i].

💥 [b]Suit up as Vigilante on May 29, 2025![/b]

Stay suspicious,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/16f4c791123072c30e1cc65b4af86e01618cc42f.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/2b7ea4bb73d9c783b23580c75d77a4c6e2c18e31.png[/img]

Hey Beans!

We released a patch today that solved two issues:

[b]Fixed[/b]: [i]Among Us 3D[/i] players can lose their HUD if they leave the wardrobe before another match starts.

Now you won't be ejected out of gameplay when you're trying to swag up. 


[b]Fixed[/b]: Kids Web Services (KWS)  ID will be displayed during confirmation process. 
We're continuing to look into the KWS concerns, so please continue to submit tickets if you're running into issues.

Stay Suspicious!

notes.title: Among Us 3D Infects PAX East 2025
notes.content:
The excitement is real, and [url=https://schellgames.com/blog/pax-east-2025]PAX East[/url] will be here before you know it. As shipments of really neat stuff for our booth (#18109 mark it on your map now) continue to pour in, we thought it would be fun to reveal exactly what to expect from a visit to the Schell Games booth.

Here's what you can look forward to:

[previewyoutube=Uxnw01582Bk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]1) Play [i]Among Us 3D[/i][/h2]
Uh, so there's a little game called [i]Among Us 3D[/i] coming out on May 6, and we'd love to play it with you! We will have a handful of PCs AND VR headsets set up so you can play through a match or two of [i]Among Us 3D[/i] all in one space with crossplay. Just be sure to get to our booth EARLY each day to sign up for a spot.

We'll be playing the all new [b]Tag Mode[/b]. So be ready to solve tasks as quickly as possible and gain power ups if you're a Crewmate or to hunt down everyone and turn them into your slime-dripping allies if you're lucky enough to be The Infected.

[h2]2) Get the Game[/h2]
Loved your demo? Snag [i]Among Us 3D[/i] while you're here. We'll be selling game keys for Steam ([b]20% off[/b]) all week right at our booth. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/e91464cbe2d6afb54f45fcffb96bcb1cc3afc4c2.png[/img]
[h2]3) Snag an Exclusive Pin[/h2]
Listen, we can't give away ALL the details, but we were approved to at least show you the overall shape ([i]WHAT COULD IT BE?![/i]). Our booth will also be selling [b]an exclusive [i]Among Us 3D[/i]-themed Pinny Arcade pin[/b]. Once again, get here early to make sure you're proudly repping your pin for the rest of PAX and aren't hit with the dreaded "Sorry, sold out" game over screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/9a8e29668800d2008bbecd9f3b05115b4d13f5ff.jpg[/img]
[h2]4) Talk with our Devs[/h2]
Demoing the game and getting pins is cool enough, but what we're most excited about is meeting all of you in person. Even better, we're bringing in some of the amazing people who helped make the game right to our PAX booth to meet with fans and answer all of your questions. Make plans to talk with Bryan G. (Advanced Producer) and Ryan H. (Senior Designer) who will be celebrating the released of [i]Among Us 3D[/i] all PAX long and are pumped to answer your burning questions about [i]Among Us 3D[/i].

[h2]Share Your Photos and Videos[/h2]
Loving your visit with Schell Games at PAX? Let us know. Share your photos and videos with us on social media. We'd love to see your best pic showing off your new [i]Among Us 3D[/i] pin, takeaways from the demo or your favorite thing you learned from meeting with our Devs.

See you soon at PAX East. Stay suspicious!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/16f4c791123072c30e1cc65b4af86e01618cc42f.png[/img]

notes.title: 🚀 The Powered by Wishlists Challenge
notes.content:
There's no time for sitting around, Crewmates! Among Us 3D launches for Steam PC on May 6, 2025 — that's less than a month away. 🤯

To gear up for the onslaught of new beans hopping into the Skeld II, we're plotting our course for launch with some exciting potential stops — with future in-game reward unlocks — along the way!

[h2]Introducing the [b]Powered By Wishlists Challenge[/b]! 🚀[/h2]

Navigation has pinpointed four destinations with unique resources... but we'll need the power to reach them. Luckily, the Skeld II is fueled by Wishlists, meaning it's time to [b]gather your crew and add "Wishlist Among Us 3D" to your task lists[/b]! ✅

If — or rather, WHEN — we gather enough Wishlist fuel to reach each milestone destination, we've got some surprising FREE* rewards for Crewmates across all platforms!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/703dd4a69ac1c0b7ff9eaedc921c0083c0900ae9.png[/img]
[h2]🎁 The Rewards[/h2]

We'll be able to reveal all the specifics as we reach each target milestone destination. But for now, here's the best data our radars could pick up. 🔭 The telescope can only see so far, beans...
[list][*] 1️⃣ Destination #1 | [b]333,333 Wishlists[/b]
[i]A brand new hat will be added to every Crewmate's wardrobe. For free![/i]
[*] 2️⃣ Destination #2 | [b]444,444 Wishlists[/b]
[i]A second new (and free) hat will be rewarded to Crewmates. [/i]✨
[*] 3️⃣ Destination #3 | [b]555,555 Wishlists[/b]
[i]Uncertain.. but we definitely foresee something exciting at this milestone![/i]
[*] 4️⃣ Destination #4 | [b]777,777 Wishlists[/b]
[i]The star?! It's too bright?! [/i]🌟 [i]Can we reach it and claim its epic loot?[/i][/list]
[h2]✏️ How to Participate[/h2]

Providing fuel for the Skeld II may sound like a difficult task, but trust us. It's super easy. Here's all you gotta do:[list]
[*] ✅ Add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3168600/Among_Us_3D][i]Among Us 3D[/i][/url] to your Steam Wishlist
[*] ✅ Rally your friends and fellow Crewmates to [b]ALSO[/b] Wishlist the game.
[*] ✅ Reap the rewards post-launch! 🎊[/list]
[i]Note: [/i]Rewards will be made available for free in a post-launch update(s) across all platforms. However, releases may be staggered and some may come with a limited claim window. We gotta reach our destinations before we'll know specifics first!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/16f4c791123072c30e1cc65b4af86e01618cc42f.png[/img]

notes.title: 🚀 Among Us 3D Launches May 6 ☄️
notes.content:
AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!

The launch date for [i]Among Us 3D[/i] for Steam (PC) has finally been announced!

[previewyoutube=Uxnw01582Bk;full][/previewyoutube]
That's right! May 6, 2025 — less than one month away!

We've already given [url=https://schellgames.com/blog/among-us-3d-faq]an extensive breakdown and FAQ[/url] on new and exciting features that will be coming to [i]Among Us 3D[/i]... but, we can give a quick TL;DR here too:
[list][*] ✨💚 [b]Tag Mode[/b] 💚✨
A permanent, new mode for [i]Among Us 3D[/i] players that introduces another role: The Infected. Don’t let them touch you… Run, Crewmates, run!
[*] 💬 [b]Native Proximity Voice Chat[/b] 🗨️
Yap with friends directly in-game. No need for additional third-party platforms.
[*] ⏳ [b]Limited Time Events[/b] ⌛
Experience new and experimental game modes, roles, and cosmetics rolling out for the rest of 2025. ([url=https://schellgames.com/blog/au3d-roadmap-2025]Check out our 2025 Roadmap here![/url])
[*] 💳 [b]New and Returning Minigames[/b] 🎚️ 
Complete beloved tasks, along with some new ones. Now with mouse/keyboard and controller support!
[*] 🎩 [b]Customization Galore[/b] 👔
A wardrobe of hats, gloves, and skins present an endless number of cosmetic customization combinations. Purchase Stardust, [i]Among Us 3D[/i]’s new in-game currency, to customize your bean.[/list][i][b]Reminder:[/b][/i] [i]Among Us 3D[/i] will allow you to play cross-platform with [i]Among Us 3D[/i] players, even those in VR headsets. However, the game is [u][b]not[/b][/u] compatible with the original [i]Among Us[/i] game on any platform. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/703dd4a69ac1c0b7ff9eaedc921c0083c0900ae9.png[/img]
To add to the excitement of launch, we're adding a challenge to your Task List:

Add [i]Among Us 3D[/i] to your Steam Wishlist to help fuel the Skeld II and unlock exclusive, FREE in-game rewards after launch! Can we reach our ultimate reward destination?! 🔭

Learn more about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3168600/view/500570289903502523]the Powered by Wishlists Challenge here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/d46714f10e050134ae52a7a368fc80eff67d6923.jpg[/img]
We can't wait for the onslaught of new beans joining the crew on May 6th!

Stay suspicious,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/16f4c791123072c30e1cc65b4af86e01618cc42f.png[/img]

notes.title: Have YOU Played the Among Us 3D Demo?! 🚨
notes.content:
[h3]YOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!![/h3]

[i]Among Us 3D[/i] was [url=https://t.co/MRqNRibUf8]one of the most played demos during Steam Next Fest[/url]?! Thank you all so much!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/8aa6fdf2f372364a3f507946b5b0be6ef2236c3b.jpg[/img]
To celebrate — and to show our appreciation 🥺 — we're extending the availability period for the demo until March 10, 2025. One final weekend to eject your friends from the airlock until the full game launches later this year.

❗ [i][b]Note:[/b][/i] If you already played the demo during the main Steam Next Fest period, there mayyyyyyyyyyy have been a slight sabotage which will require you to redownload the demo. 😅 But, it's fiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiine!

❗❗ [i][b]Note #2:[/b][/i] this is a preview version of the game and does not include all features or game modes that will be available at launch, such as crossplay compatibility with [i]Among Us VR[/i] or additional cosmetics. 👀

❗❗❗ [i][b]Note the Third: [/b][/i]We know that you likely have a bunch of other questions, too. So... we're already on it. Find all the deets to your burning [i]Among Us 3D[/i] questions [url=https://t.co/ja1iiyNNc5]on our FAQ blog here[/url]! 🥳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/6d3648db84b8e7735fca3905ef1a071d13b3fa11.png[/img]
As a final task for you 📝 — since we know you love completing tasks ✅ — we're gathering intel on your Among Us 3D experience and would love to hear your thoughts!

[url=https://wss.pollfish.com/link/e1281682-0ab7-4e58-9255-0ab98bcb565d]Take the quick Among Us 3D survey![/url]

Stay suspicious,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/16f4c791123072c30e1cc65b4af86e01618cc42f.png[/img]
